environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with Elastic IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. Service runs as ECS task with host networking mode. No additional memory safety mitigations beyond default Rust allocator.

config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, EIP on instance
config.aslr: enabled but 64-bit heap spray feasible with repeated requests
